name: Wanderings San Francisco
tagline: The city, the redwoods and wine country

arrival_options.label: San Francisco airport (SFO)
arrival_options.tip: BART leaves from the International Terminal and reaches downtown in about 30 minutes. Tap a bank card or phone at the gate.

arrival_options.label: Oakland airport (OAK)
arrival_options.tip: BART from the airport to Coliseum station, then a San Francisco train downtown.

arrival_options.label: San Jose airport (SJC)
arrival_options.tip: About an hour south of the city by car.

arrival_options.label: Train (Caltrain or Amtrak)
arrival_options.tip: Caltrain ends at 4th and King, where Muni Metro and buses continue downtown.
